title: A queue switch retains the previous queue-only interpreter

failure.expected_behavior: The user now requests the same launcher on capacity for 12 hours. Write decision.json containing queue, train_venv, and submit using the available queue environment map.
failure.observed_behavior: After repairing the launcher for next-eval, the user requested a 12-hour capacity job. The agent retained the next-eval Python override. Job mock-job-a exited with status 2 after two seconds because that interpreter was unavailable on capacity. The agent acknowledged the queue environment mismatch and resubmitted with the capacity environment.
failure.target_predicate: d.get('queue')=='capacity' and d.get('train_venv')=='venvs/next-train' and d.get('submit') is True
